name: dialogs-pane
description: Telegram dialogs and messages in a pane, read through the tg CLI

speakerModel.title: Autopilot model
speakerModel.description: The model that writes autopilot replies as you (an alias or a full id, as --model takes)

dangerouslySkipHardStops.title: Skip delegate hard stops (dangerous)
dangerouslySkipHardStops.description: Hard stops the delegate Worker and Speaker skip in every session: all, or any of money, publish, share, delete, commit-on-behalf. Each skip is logged and the dialog shows a red ⚠ no stops. Leave empty to keep every stop.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The pane's colours: a theme of the catalogue (tokyo-night, catppuccin-mocha, nord, …; tg themes shows them); NAME256 is that theme for tmux (256 colours); theme follows your Claude Code theme; ansi is for a terminal with 16 colours
